patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero and feature sections, often pairing a large image or illustration with a text block and call-to-action on the opposite side.
Prominent use of an elegant, slightly condensed serif typeface for main section headings, contrasting with clean sans-serif for body text and UI elements.

A core palette of deep teal and light, muted greens is accented by soft pastels (pink, light blue, pale yellow) for section backgrounds and card elements, creating an approachable yet sophisticated feel.

The primary navigation bar starts transparent over the hero, then becomes sticky and gains a solid dark teal background upon scroll. Sections below the hero reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections with varied background colors, often featuring a large, impactful headline and clear sub-sections for features, testimonials, and FAQs.

technique_notes: To rebuild the scroll-triggered motion, implement a sticky header that transitions its background color and potentially its height as the user scrolls past a certain point, using JavaScript to add/remove classes or directly manipulate styles. For section reveals, use an Intersection Observer API or a library like GSAP ScrollTrigger to apply a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation animation to content blocks as they become visible in the viewport. Carousels within sections (detected as 'swiper') should be implemented using a dedicated slider library to manage horizontal content navigation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with generous line height, complemented by clean sans-serif subheadings and legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle: buttons and cards feature a slight corner radius, while most images maintain sharp edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy: generous vertical padding between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of openness, with balanced spacing for readability within content blocks.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its sophisticated and approachable aesthetic, achieved through the unique pairing of an elegant, slightly condensed serif typeface for major headings with a soft, inviting pastel color palette. This combination creates a warm yet authoritative feel that avoids the clinical or overly playful common in the mental health space.
